items.title: investingLive Asia-pacific FX news wrap 6 Aug: USD moves higher with yields ahead of US jobs report
items.summary: Treasury yields moved sharply higher on Thursday, with the two-year note rising more than 7 basis points and the benchmark 10-year yield climbing nearly 6 basis points to 4.67%. The move was fueled by another round of solid U.S. economic data, including better-than-expected initial jobless claims that reinforced the view the labor market remains resilient.
items.impactZh: 关键宏观数据超预期时，点差与滑点风险通常放大，建议降低仓位并控制杠杆。
items.impactEn: When macro data surprises, spread/slippage risk often widens; consider smaller position size and tighter leverage control.
items.summaryZh: 美国国债收益率周四大幅走高，两年期国债上涨逾7个基点，基准10年期国债收益率攀升近6个基点至4.67%。此举是由另一轮稳健的美国经济数据推动的，其中包括优于预期的初始失业救济申请，这强化了劳动力市场保持弹性的观点。
